text: The two remaining cafes may be confirmed as the converfe of thote under Prop. II. (p. 548-), because the incident rays in there are the reflected ones in them; or they may be demothered in the fame manner with the forgoing, as follows.

parsed.faithful: The two remaining cafes may be confirmed as the converfe of thote under Prop. II. (p. 548-), because the incident rays in there are the reflected ones in them; or they may be demothered in the fame manner with the forgoing, as follows.
parsed.modern: The two remaining cases may be confirmed as the converse of those under Prop. II. (p. 548-), because the incident rays in there are the reflected ones in them; or they may be demonstrated in the same manner with the foregoing, as follows.
